pr_title: [Pictures] Fix exif parsing regression from v19
pr_body: ## Description This fixes EXIF parsing which has been broken since v19. This is a regression from: https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/commit/f894813ad1dbc38be36388b8facbd6d6e1487bc2 Fixes https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/issues/23360 Fixes https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/issues/22900 ## Motivation and context The code will be nuked for v22 but lets have something actually working for v21. ## How has this been tested? Runtime tested on macOS ## What is the effect on users? Exif parsing should now be working. ## Screenshots (if appropriate): **Prev:** **Now:** ## Types of change - [x] **Bug fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) - [ ] **Clean up** (non-breaking change which removes non-working, unmaintained functionality) - [ ] **Improvement** (non-breaking change which improves existing functionality) - [ ] **New feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality) - [ ] **Breaking change** (fix or feature that will cause existing functionality to change) - [ ] **Cosmetic change** (non-breaking change that doesn't touch code) - [ ] **Student submission** (PR was done for educational purposes and will be treated as such) - [ ] **None of the above** (please explain below)

issue_context.title: Pictures - Date of a picture is not using EXIF "DateTimeOriginal"
issue_context.body:
<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->
<!--- Read the following link before you create a new problem report: https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Submit_a_bug_report  -->
## Bug report
### Describe the bug
Here is a clear and concise description of what the problem is:
<!--- Provide a more detailed introduction to the issue itself, and why you consider it to be a bug -->
<!--- A bug report that is not clear will be closed -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
In Pictures when viewing the picture's Date it is not using EXIF's "DateTimeOriginal" .  It is using "ModifyDate".  
This is a change in behaviour from previous versions, 19.X at least, of Kodi.   
This means that the sort of pictures by "Date taken" is using "ModifyDate" as well.   



## Expected Behavior
Here is a clear and concise description of what was expected to happen:
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
When viewing pictures the "Date" of the picture should use EXIF's "DateTimeOriginal" as in previous versions of Kodi.  
Sorting by "Date Taken" should also use EXIF "DateTimeOriginal".   
Summary:  EXIF "DateTimeOriginal" should be used for "Date" in Kodi.


## Actual Behavior
The Date of a picture is EXIF "ModifyDate" and sorting by "Date taken" is also using "ModifyDate" instead of using "DateTimeOriginal".


## Possible Fix
As in previous 19.X, at least, version of Kodi used "DateTimeOriginal" for the "Date" being displayed in Kodi.  If this field is use for Date I suspect the sorting by "Date taken" in Kodi will also be corrected.



### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
<!--- Provide a link to a live example, or an unambiguous set of steps to -->
<!--- reproduce this bug. Include code to reproduce, if relevant -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
1. Go to Pictures.
2. Select one picture and look at the date information of a picture in a tool like ExifTool or ExifToolGui.
3. Note "ModifyDate" "DateTimeOriginal" "CreateDate"
4. Modify the "DateTimeOriginal" field.   
5. Notice this change in date isn't displayed in Kodi.
6. *Note the field "ModifyDate" is not the field you see in Windows Explorer "Date modified".


### Debuglog
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
<!--- A debuglog is always mandatory when creating an issue. Provide one! -->
The debuglog can be found here:



### Screenshots 
Here are some links or screenshots to help explain the problem:
<!--- Put your text below this line -->



## Additional context or screenshots (if appropriate)
Here is some additional context or explanation that might help:
<!--- How has this bug affected you? What were you trying to accomplish? -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
I have made modifications  to "TimeDateCreated" to pictures in a folder that has pictures from multiple cameras.   The cameras, unfortunately, did not have their time's synchronized.   Now I can't sort by this field. 


### Your Environment
Used Operating system:

Team Kodi will consider your problem report however, we will not make any promises the problem will be solved.*
comments:
Hello,

+1 for this issue! it is  being quite a problem for correct sorting out of pictures.

By the way I found another issue with  EXIF tag "UserComment" not being reported correctly although they were perfectly ok in Matrix or Leia when used in Slideshow labels for example:

$INFO[Slideshow.EXIFComment]       : gives now an empty string despite it is not empty at all
$INFO[Slideshow.SlideComment]       : supposed to be same as previous one, according to documentation, but now gives something weird about lavc software version. Not empty though if the documentation should be right...

Would that mean more deeply broken stuff in EXIF tags management ?
